Name: Deck for AXIS Camera Station Edge
Author: Pavel Kotyza
Description: Playback, PTZ and view controls for AXIS Camera Station Edge (web app or Windows client) on Stream Deck keys: previous / next recording, ±0.5 s, play / pause, zoom, pan / tilt, stream details. Ready-made profiles for Stream Deck, Mini and XL. Independent project, not affiliated with Axis Communications or Elgato. https://www.4xs.dev
Category: Deck for AXIS Camera Station Edge

Actions.Name: ACS Edge Command
Actions.Tooltip: Sends one AXIS Camera Station Edge keyboard shortcut to the focused window: previous / next recording, ±0.5 s, play / pause, zoom, pan / tilt, stream details, debug info, shortcut help.

Actions.Name: Open ACS Edge
Actions.Tooltip: Opens AXIS Camera Station Edge — the web app (acs.mysystems.axis.com) by default, or any URL you set.
